name: LJSpeech
description: A public-domain corpus of approximately 24 hours of single-speaker English audiobook speech, comprising 13,100 short audio clips with aligned transcripts, commonly used for text-to-speech research.
citation: Ito, K. (2017). The LJ Speech Dataset. https://keithito.com/LJ-Speech-Dataset/
